parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.conversation_id) throw new Error('conversation_id required'); return [{json:{conversation_id:b.conversation_id,max_messages:Math.min(b.max_messages??20,50)}}];

parameters.query: SELECT c.id conversation_id, c.context, stm.summary, stm.slots, COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('direction',m.direction,'type',m.message_type,'body',m.body,'created_at',m.created_at) ORDER BY m.created_at) FILTER (WHERE m.id IS NOT NULL),'[]'::jsonb) recent_messages FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN short_term_memory stm ON stm.conversation_id=c.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=c.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $2) m ON true WHERE c.id=$1::uuid GROUP BY c.id,stm.summary,stm.slots;
